Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000628": The Cinder team observed that the auth gateway's cold start time tripled after the runtime upgrade.  (about: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade)
- memory_id "1000575": INC-2025-017 was an incident where the auth gateway rejected every login for 12 minutes on 2025-08-02.  (about: auth gateway, INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000650": On 2025-09-16, the Ember team handed the authentication gateway over to the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, Ember team, authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000248": The ledger service depends on the auth gateway for service tokens.  (about: ledger service, auth gateway)
- memory_id "1000727": As of 2025-10-13, the ledger service is owned by the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000395": The Cinder team observed that the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week after the cache change.  (about: Cinder team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change)
- memory_id "1000749": As of 2025-10-16, the Cinder team sits on the third floor.  (about: Cinder team)
- memory_id "1000664": As of 2025-09-23, the pager for the job scheduler rings the Cinder team.  (about: Cinder team, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000682": As of 2025-09-23, the reporting service uses the bus as its source instead of the ledger service, because the nightly ledger scans were blocking billing runs.  (about: ledger service, billing API, the bus, reporting service)
- memory_id "1000667": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler; team Dune owned it until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000660": As of 2025-09-23, the Cinder team owns the job scheduler, which team Dune owned until then.  (about: Cinder team, team Dune, job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000548" [constraint]: Per policy, every authentication gateway change requires two reviewer approvals and a security sign-off.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000723": From 2025-10-13, the pager for the ledger service rings the Cinder team, not the Atlas team.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder team, ledger service)
- memory_id "1000910" [decision]: As of 2026-01-12, the billing API is owned by the Ember team, which the Atlas team owned until then.  (about: Atlas team, billing API, Ember team)
- memory_id "1000759" [decision]: Webhooks will sign payloads with rotating keys, since a partner asked for key rotation in their security review.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000615" [decision]: As of 2025-09-02, clients will cache feature-flags evaluations for 30 seconds.  (about: feature-flags, clients)
- memory_id "1000579": The root cause of INC-2025-017 was an expired intermediate certificate.  (about: INC-2025-017)
- memory_id "1000831": As of 2025-12-01, the billing API's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from Boreal team.  (about: Boreal team, billing API, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000373": The authentication gateway's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump.  (about: authentication gateway, the dependency bump)
- memory_id "1000138": The authentication gateway is owned by the Ember team.  (about: Ember team, authentication gateway)
Existing entity names: Cinder team, auth gateway, the runtime upgrade, INC-2025-017, Ember team, authentication gateway, ledger service, Atlas team, webhook dispatcher, the cache change, job scheduler, billing API, the bus, reporting service, team Dune, feature-flags, clients, Boreal team, the dependency bump
